brief_issues: Under v5 V3a the pilot-2 reference for this article (yes, with the manufacturer's hazard-ratio model) is superseded; V9(i)'s note still cites this article's Table 1 HR as a missed procedure, which now conflicts with V3a and should be reworded. Whether GRADE pooled RRs count as the work group's own estimates remains a gray zone.
